title: The Village Idiot and the Impossible Invention

collection.credit:
* V10 reputation, appointment, school and rivalry events: event prose
  and detailed branching by ChatGPT. Requested social outcomes and
  leadership roles, including ostracism, laughingstock, village idiot,
  mad scientist, trusted advisor, teacher and heads of professions:
  Lorsieab2. VV3–VV5-only Magic/Nature faction rule: Lorsieab2.

ledger.why: reputations are story only (rule 7); no promotion

items.text: (Subject) earns genuine respect for careful observation.
The invention wins a small prize, and the former mockers apologize.
The inventor accepts the criticism and returns with a better design next season.
A Master Scientist offers mentorship, insisting that enthusiasm is not a substitute for evidence.
(Subject) insists the bubbling yogurt is "ALIVE!" The healer replies, "That is not the reassuring statement you think it is."
(Subject) wears a dramatic cloak woven from tough vines. It gets caught on a door.
(Subject) names a jar of slug slime "THE FUTURE." The village leaders ask that it be kept outside.
A rival admits that the experiment was clever. (Subject) faints theatrically.
(Subject) becomes known as the village's eccentric experimentalist, not as someone inherently foolish.
"I can survive being wrong," says (Subject). "I just wish you wouldn't enjoy it so much."
An elder says, "Some of your ideas are dreadful. That doesn't make you dreadful."
A child offers (Subject) a tiny wooden trophy labeled MOST IMPROVED FAILURE.
The loudest critic admits to once building a bridge that led directly into a pond.
(Subject) keeps experimenting, but begins recording failures as carefully as successes.

intro.name: Dreadful ideas
intro.text:
(Subject) has become famous for proposing dreadful ideas: a chair held together with fermented fruit juice, a roof made from tree bark and rotten wood, and a ceremonial necklace fashioned from {polished pearls|pulverized gemstones|crushed-up snail shells}.
After the latest failure, some villagers cruelly call (Subject) "the village idiot."
(Subject) hears them.

question.name: A new experiment
question.text: Then (subject.he/she) announces a new experiment involving {volcanic ash and crushed snail shells|spider silk and tough vines|yeast and fermented yogurt|tree bark and animal rawhide}.

choices.label: OFFER SUPERVISION AND A FAIR TEST.
TELL (NAME1) TO STOP BEFORE ANYONE IS HURT.

t1.text: The material works surprisingly well for a harmless decorative application.

t2.text: The invention fails, but the observations reveal something useful about material strength.

t3.text: The experiment creates a horrible smell. The judges retreat in an orderly fashion.

t4.text: The inventor has accidentally reinvented a technique an elder has used for forty years.

t5.text: The invention is impressive but unsafe for its intended use; the village declines to deploy it.

w1.text: (Subject) feels humiliated and stops presenting ideas. An elder later encourages a safer project.

w2.text: (Subject) angrily declares (subject.himself/herself) a MAD SCIENTIST and starts wearing a ridiculous leaf-covered hat.

w3.text: The leaders establish sensible testing rules rather than forbidding experimentation entirely.

w4.text: A child asks why mistakes are funny when adults make them but shameful when children do.
